messages.html:
okay, big brain dump, feel free to skip:

The thing about keeping a record of a conversation is that it stops being a transcript the moment you decide how to lay it out. Choose the typeface and you have chosen the tone. Choose the margins and you have chosen how much air the words get to breathe. A chat log says look at all of this, quickly; a book says here, slowly.

What I want is the second one. I want the Tuesday in March where we argued about hot dogs to sit next to the evening at the pier like they are chapters of the same, small, ridiculous novel.

Anyway. I pick cream paper and a deep red for the names. You get a vote but I have already decided.
